Thus, the best choice is D. Bizarre, as it accurately describes both the unconventional action and the strange movie.

S+ has/have+been + V4+object + since/for + time

Hence, option (C) is the correct choice.

questions.question: The ratio of income of Rahul for two consecutive years is 2:3 and the ratio of his expenditures is 5:9. If Rahul’s income for the second year is Rs 45,000 and the expenditure of the first year is Rs 25,000. Then his savings of two years is ?
questions.explanation:
Given Information:

  • Ratio of Rahul’s income for two consecutive years = 2 : 3

  • Ratio of Rahul’s expenditure for two consecutive years = 5 : 9

  • Income of the second year = Rs 45,000

  • Expenditure of the first year = Rs 25,000

  • Required: Total savings of two years

Calculation:

Let the income of Rahul for the first and second year be 2x and 3x respectively.

And the expenditures are 5y and 9y respectively.

ATQ, \(3x = 45000 \Rightarrow x = 15000.\)

Total income of Rahul \(= (2x + 3x) = 5 \times 15000 = 75000\)

Also, \(5y = 25000 \Rightarrow y = 5000\)

Total expenditure of Rahul\(= (5y + 9y) = 14 \times 5000 = 70000\)

Total savings of Rahul\(= 75000 - 70000 = 5000.\)
Hence, option B is correct.

  • Income and expenditure in a ratio can be assumed as multiples of a common variable

  • Savings = Income − Expenditure

  • Total savings = Savings of first year + Savings of second year
